entities.name: Dwarven Gate
entities.description: Planar portal beneath Castle Sengir leading from Ulgrotha to an unknown plane; no longer functions since the Mending.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire baron who wished to conquer Ulgrotha and march troops through the portal.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: Castle on Ulgrotha above the Dwarven Gate.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane the Dwarven Gate leads from.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who saw the vampire army marching.

entities.name: Ihsan's Shade
entities.description: Ordered the great army of vampires to march.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Confronted Sengir on the far side of the Gate in the BOOM! Comics version.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event on whose eve the army marched; since then the portal is dead.

events.summary: Baron Sengir plans to conquer Ulgrotha and march troops through the portal.
events.quote: Baron Sengir wished to conquer Ulgrotha

events.summary: On the eve of the Great Mending, Leshrac sees a vast vampire army march at Ihsan's Shade's order, the Baron at its head walking through the portal.
events.quote: The Baron was last seen at the head of this army, walking through the portal.

relations.quote: The Dwarven Gate was a planar portal beneath Castle Sengir
